patthana1.13:282.1: paritto ca appamāṇo ca dhammā appamāṇassa dhammassa .. sahajātaṃ purejātaṃ.
patthana1.13:283.1: paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā parittassa dhammassa .. sahajātaṃ pacchājātaṃ āhāraṃ indriyaṃ.
patthana1.13:284.1: paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā mahaggatassa dhammassa .. sahajātaṃ purejātaṃ.
patthana1.13:285.1: nahetuyā pannarasa naārammaṇe pannarasa naadhipatiyā naanantare nasamanantare pannarasa nasahajāte dvādasa naaññamaññe dvādasa nanissaye dvādasa naupanissaye cuddasa na purejāte cuddasa napacchājāte pannarasa naāsevane. saṅkhittaṃ. namagge pannarasa nasampayutte dvādasa navippayutte dasa noatthiyā dasa nonatthiyā pannarasa novigate pannarasa noavigate dasa. evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.
patthana1.13:287.1: hetupaccayā naārammaṇe satta .. naadhipatiyā naanantare nasamanantare satta naaññamaññe tīṇi naupanissaye satta napurejāte. saṅkhittaṃ. namagge satta nasampayutte tīṇi navippayutte tīṇi nonatthiyā satta novigate satta. evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.
patthana1.13:289.1: nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe satta .. adhipatiyā satta anantare nava samanantare nava sahajāte ekādasa aññamaññe satta nissaye terasa upanissaye nava purejāte tīṇi pacchājāte tīṇi āsevane cattāri kamme satta. saṅkhittaṃ. magge satta sampayutte tīṇi vippayutte pañca atthiyā terasa natthiyā nava vigateṃ nava avigate terasa.
